scoring_justification: Headline quantities are the final computed values from geometry optimizations. The output contract only requires the final angles and heat, not intermediate raw geometries or energies, so T1 recompute from raw is infeasible. T0 result-level compare with tolerant exact match against the paper-reported gold is appropriate.
